memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: "When Joseph came home, they presented to him the gifts they had brought into the house, and they bowed down before him to the ground. He asked them how they were, and then he said, 'How is your aged father you told me about? Is he still living?' They replied, 'Your servant our father is still alive and well.' And they bowed down, prostrating themselves before him." - Gen 43:26-28 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
When Joseph enters, the brothers bow low and present their gifts — once again fulfilling his old dreams without knowing it. But notice the first thing on Joseph's heart. Before anything else, he asks, "How is your aged father... Is he still living?" Even now, after years of separation and all that he has become, Joseph's thoughts turn tenderly to his father, Jacob.

This is a beautiful window into Joseph's heart. He is the second most powerful man in Egypt, surrounded by wealth and honour, yet his deep concern is for his elderly father far away in Canaan. Success and status had not dulled his love for his family, nor made him forget the old man who had grieved him for so long. His first question is not about business or gifts, but about his father's wellbeing.

There is a challenge here for us. Sometimes as life fills up with responsibilities, achievements, and new relationships, our care for parents and family can quietly fade into the background. But Joseph reminds us to keep honouring and cherishing those who raised us and love us, no matter how far we have risen or how busy life has become. "Honour your father and mother" remains God's command and delight (Eph 6:2).

How is your aged father? How is your family? Let Joseph's tender question prompt your own. Do not let success or busyness crowd out love and care for those God has given you.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
1. Has success or busyness dulled my care for family and parents?
2. What is the first thing on my heart when I have opportunity?
3. How can I honour and cherish those who love me this week?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Lord, keep my heart tender toward my family, no matter how life fills up. Help me to honour my parents and cherish those You have given me, never letting busyness crowd out love. Amen.
